title: Readiness (closing Clio gaps)
summary: What a firm needs before it trusts a new practice app with its files and trust money: security proof (SOC 2, SOC 1, SLA, status page), provable Canadian residency for storage and model calls, integrations (two-way QuickBooks Online Canada and Xero), payments, mobile web, mail add-ins, research, and a safe move from Clio. French is a possible edge (no French Clio interface found), not a gap.

screens.layout: Top: certification status cards. Middle: controls checklist with evidence links. Bottom: uptime history, incident log and sub-processor list.

screens.agent: Fills security questionnaires (insurers, clients) from the controls list and cites the policy behind each answer. Computes monthly uptime against the SLA and drafts any service credit.

Status page down with the app: hosted outside the firm cell so it stays reachable

screens.agent: Maps Clio fields to ours, flags duplicates and missing data, and reconciles every client trust balance to the cut-over bank statement.

screens.reg: Trust records must stay complete and continuous across the move; 10-year retention (verify).

open_questions: Order of work: security certification and the Clio importer first (needed to win any firm), then integrations?
Payments: which Canadian-capable provider for card, PAD, EFT and Interac, and do we hold merchant accounts or the firm does?
Mobile: installable web app first, or native apps?
Research: public sources only at launch, or license content (CanLII API terms vs commercial)?
Second province after Ontario: BC or Alberta?
French interface in v1 or v1.1? (Possible edge: no French Clio UI found.)
Inference: can every model call run in a Canadian region (e.g. a Canada-region endpoint)? If not, drop 'all in Canada' wording.
Could: directory filters on integrations-hub by province, practice area and category.
Could: mobile tap-to-pay (verify provider support in Canada; retainers to trust only).
Could: 'ask the agent' and document upload in the mobile web app (Clio has a native Vincent app).
Could: quarterly restore-test row in trust center beyond the escrow screen.
Could: seek FOLA / county law association member listing (go-to-market, no screen).

clio_gaps.clio_feature: Years of track record, large customer base
clio_gaps.note: Pilot alongside Clio, measured hours saved, first reference firm.

clio_gaps.clio_feature: SOC 2 Type II and SOC 1 Type II, annual pen tests, bug bounty
clio_gaps.note: trust-center: SOC 2 Type I then II, SOC 1 Type II for trust controls, report request with NDA. Source r12 (clio.com/ca/security, Wayback May 2026).
trust-center SLA fields, status-page, G-SLA credit note. Source r12.

clio_gaps.clio_feature: Canadian data region (opt-in, ca.app.clio.com); Clio help says AI processing may temporarily leave the region
clio_gaps.note: Canada only for every firm, with model inference region and a per-call residency log; claim held until Canadian inference is contracted. Source r12, r08 (help 53337803186715). Clio stores Canadian data in Canada; its help articles say AI processing may temporarily occur outside the region (its Canadian security page claims in-region processing) (r03, r08, r12).

support-access: owner grant, scope, expiry, logged. Clio already requires explicit in-app firm consent for support access (r12), so this is parity plus scope, not a gap; consistent with access.json support-access.
Focused launch set plus 'Request a connector'; API phased; see platform api-and-webhooks (v1 API keys + id-only webhooks; v1.1 OAuth apps; reports API later). Source r11 (app directory, Oct 2026).
integrations-hub two-way QBO Canada / Xero, trust summary only. Source r11.

clio_gaps.clio_feature: Clio Payments (Canada: cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay; no EFT/PAD)
clio_gaps.note: payments-setup adds PAD, EFT, Interac e-Transfer; fees never from trust. Source r06 (help 41863402264091).

clio_gaps.clio_feature: Clio Accounting for Canada (Sept 2026): bank feeds, auto-match, locking reconciliation
clio_gaps.note: Trust area daily matching and locked months; not a unique edge. Source r06, r12.

clio_gaps.clio_feature: Mobile apps, Outlook add-in, server-side email filing
clio_gaps.note: Planned, not built: installable web app with scan, mail add-ins. Server-side filing is parity, not an edge. Source r04, r11.

clio_gaps.clio_feature: Clio Work: AI research and drafting, Canadian case law (Jul 2026), agentic mode (Apr 2026), US$199/user/mo at launch
clio_gaps.note: Partial: research on public sources with checked citations; Clio has the deeper corpus. Our difference is approval gates on agent runs. Source r08, r12, r14.
clio-import via Canada-region API, Document Archives, Reports API, webhook renewal. Source r11.

clio_gaps.clio_feature: Canadian provinces: Alberta trust report, BC trust fee, few Canadian court-rule sets
clio_gaps.note: Ontario first with LSO By-Law 9 / Form 9A and Ontario court rules; other provinces as rule packs. Source r12 (help 9289840995867, 14353332840603).
No French Clio UI found (third-party review); French is a possible edge for us. Source r12.

clio_gaps.clio_feature: Pricing: Starter from CA$69/user/mo; Core, Signature, Elite quote-only, AI from Core
clio_gaps.note: pricing-plan: public CAD per-firm price with AI included. Source r12 (Wayback Sept 2026).
